experiment.title: Lab size, from everyone alone to one lab of everyone, on a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 3 bits per level
experiment.description: The simple model with 24 identical agents on a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 3 bits per level, 6 levels × 8 ideas, 2 parents each, composition 0.7; each graph run 5 times. Traditional rules (α = 1, nothing published before a target), with agents in equal labs of 1 (alone), 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 or 24 (one lab of everyone); lab mates share every proof at once, privately. Against OSO across the whole field at α = 0.8 and 0.2. Held fixed: equal money per agent every round (f = 0), no flat mint, a knowledge reward of 1 per new bit flowing back with α, no validation.
experiment.question: On a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 3 bits per level, with 24 agents in labs of 1 to 24 that share inside the lab, how much money does the field need, against OSO across the whole field?
experiment.compare: labs of 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 and 24 against field-wide OSO at α = 0.8 and 0.2, by budget
experiment.fixed: a generated idea graph (6 levels × 8 ideas, 2 parents each, sequences of 3 bits growing by 2 per level, composition 0.7), 24 identical agents, budget 75 split equally, no mint, no validation
